title: The Shape of Returning · original procedural landscape

scenes.label: A departure
scenes.description: A drop leaves the ocean as invisible water vapor.

scenes.label: An invisible departure
scenes.description: Sunlight supplies energy for evaporation; a magnified symbolic view makes water vapor visible.

scenes.label: A gathering
scenes.description: Cooling water vapor condenses into tiny liquid droplets suspended in a cloud.

scenes.label: The fall
scenes.description: Precipitation returns water to land; the scene follows one possible path.

scenes.label: The hidden journey
scenes.description: Water infiltrates soil and flows slowly through pores and cracks, with timescales compressed.

scenes.label: A return, not an ending
scenes.description: Rivers and groundwater connect back to the sea while other pathways remain possible.
